rows.notes: The study is a systematic literature review (46 selected articles on AI and remote sensing for crop water stress assessment) with no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; Q1 is 'no'. It tabulates and summarises accuracies reported by other studies (Tables 2-14) and discusses GANs and XAI. It does not address AI-driven decision support systems for nitrogen management or salinity mitigation; its subject is crop water stress detection, not soil health. Salinity appears only in a summary of Das et al. [63] on wheat on sodic soils, which is a cited result and concerns water status/yield prediction, not salinity mitigation.

notes: Document is a review article (Sensors 2024, 24, 6313); full text appears complete including references. Some pages contain duplicated/garbled text from an overlaid peer-review version but content is readable.
